# MatchaSMP

> Last updated: 2026-11-01. MatchaSMP is a free, non pay-to-win Minecraft survival SMP with crossplay between Java, Bedrock, Xbox, PlayStation and Switch, and playtime sync (inventory, XP) via linked accounts. It runs a custom survival rework for Minecraft 26.3 that makes progression slow and casual-friendly. Full player documentation: https://matchasmp.eu/wiki.html

## How to join
- Java: play.matchasmp.eu (Minecraft Java 26.3 required)
- Bedrock: play.matchasmp.eu, port 19132
- Console (Xbox / PlayStation / Switch): add "MatchaSMP" as a friend, then join from the Friends tab. The console's online subscription is required by the console maker.
- Java players get the MatchaSMP resource pack (item names and textures) automatically when they join; no manual download is needed. Bedrock cannot load it and shows vanilla textures; everything still works.
- Bedrock names get a "_" prefix (e.g. _Steve) so they never clash with Java names.

## Theme
Fair, friendly survival for players who like to take their time. Strictly non pay-to-win: the store sells only quality-of-life items and cosmetics. Playable from anywhere, even from a plane over the Atlantic.

## Target players
Casual and adult survival players, friend groups, and players on different platforms who want one shared world.

## Gameplay
- Custom survival rework: reworked progression with alloys (Hepatizon, Shakudo, Steel, Electrum, Adamant) smithed onto copper, iron and diamond; about 50 new foods; new structures; reworked villager trades and enchanting; around 100 fish via the Angler's Almanac; 7 new music discs; about 1275 recipes and 880 advancements that guide players.
- No natural regeneration and no hunger; healing comes from food effects.
- Deaths keep the inventory and XP but cost 1 maximum heart (never below 10 hearts on Easy). Crystal Hearts restore hearts, up to 30.
- Creepers, spiders and other non-undead monsters don't spawn in the open; zombies and skeletons still do at night. The surface becomes fully safe after the Ender Dragon is first defeated. No phantoms. True darkness. Explosions drop every block.
- Nether and End are currently closed and open in stages; the Nether opens after the next major update.
- Ranks Bronze, Gold and Diamond raise ender chest size (3 to 6 rows), homes (2 to 6) and order-market slots (5 to 15), plus a name tag.
- Points currency, a player order market (5 to 15 active orders, 14-day expiry), safe player trades with a 20-second cooldown, an RTP cannon (no /rtp), global chat (no ranged chat or shouting), lockable chests, /vote for points, Order and eShop NPCs at spawn, rentable spawn rooms (contact @Foxof7207), an AFK zone instead of a disconnect, proximity voice chat (Java, push-to-talk on Caps Lock), and a /menu for Bedrock players.
- AFK: marked after 5 minutes idle, disconnected after 10 more; if the main server restarts while idle, players land in the AFK zone and return with /server smp.

## Server facts
- Hosted in France, around 100 ms from the US
- Easy difficulty, up to 20 players, no whitelist, online mode (legitimate accounts only)
- PvP allowed with fair play; griefing and stealing forbidden (warning, then temporary ban); no land claiming
- World resets every season; a copy is available on request via Discord one week after the season ends
- Staff contact and ban appeals: Discord ticket (fastest) or gilly-smp@outlook.com

## Long-tail guides
Short, question-shaped pages answering specific MatchaSMP queries. Each page is a consolidated hub with self-contained answers (FAQPage structured data). Translations live under /fr/guides/, /de/guides/ and /es/guides/.
- [Joining a Crossplay Minecraft Server](https://matchasmp.eu/guides/join.html): How to join a crossplay Minecraft survival server from Java, Bedrock, Xbox, PlayStation or Switch: addresses, ports, versions, accounts and the resource pack.
- [Crossplay & Shared Progress](https://matchasmp.eu/guides/crossplay.html): How Java, Bedrock and console players share one Minecraft world: account linking, shared progress, usernames, resource packs and voice chat explained.
- [Death, Hearts & Healing](https://matchasmp.eu/guides/death-and-healing.html): Why Minecraft health doesn't regenerate on this survival rework, what dying costs in maximum hearts, and how to heal with food, potions and Crystal Hearts.
- [Mobs, Phantoms & Darkness](https://matchasmp.eu/guides/mobs-and-darkness.html): Why creepers and phantoms are rare on this Minecraft survival rework, how true darkness works, when the surface is safe and how sleeping speeds up nights.
- [Alloys, Stations & Tools](https://matchasmp.eu/guides/alloys-and-stations.html): How to make steel, Hepatizon and Electrum alloys in Minecraft, which stations unlock first, where silver is found and why iron needs a Blast Furnace.
- [Recipes & Advancements](https://matchasmp.eu/guides/recipes-and-advancements.html): Find every recipe and follow the advancements in a custom Minecraft survival rework, including on Bedrock, where the in-game menus are limited.
- [World, Difficulty & Dimensions](https://matchasmp.eu/guides/world-and-dimensions.html): Minecraft survival world guide covering Easy difficulty, terrain, when the Nether and End open, Nether portal alignment, season resets and the world border.
- [Ender Chest, Homes & Ranks](https://matchasmp.eu/guides/ranks-and-storage.html): How ender chest rows, homes, public homes and sharing work on a Minecraft survival server, and what each rank unlocks, from the default tier up to Diamond.
- [Server Economy: Points, Orders & Trading](https://matchasmp.eu/guides/points-orders-trading.html): How a player-driven Minecraft survival economy works: server points, buy orders that pay out while you're offline, player trades, payments and referral rewards.
- [Chat, Voice Chat & AFK](https://matchasmp.eu/guides/chat-voice-afk.html): How global chat, private messages, spam filtering, Java voice chat and AFK rules work on a Minecraft survival server, with the commands you need.
- [Server Rules & Quality of Life](https://matchasmp.eu/guides/rules-support-qol.html): Survival server rules on PvP, griefing, cheat mods and land claims, plus quality-of-life tweaks, ban appeals and how to reach staff on a Minecraft server.
- [Find a Matcha Flavoured Server](https://matchasmp.eu/guides/matcha-server.html): How to choose a Matcha Flavoured Minecraft server: what to check for server-side install, pay-to-win, platforms and crossplay. MatchaSMP is one European option.
- [What Is Matcha Flavoured?](https://matchasmp.eu/guides/what-is-matcha.html): What is Matcha Flavoured? A Minecraft datapack that removes hunger and natural regeneration, adds alloys and makes death less punishing for casual players.
- [All guides](https://matchasmp.eu/guides/): index of every topic hub.
